task: Astronomy_002: Local Distance Network H0 Measurement
primary_goal: Achieve ~1% precision measurement of H0 using a covariance-weighted GLS approach combining multiple distance indicators

explicit_commitments.method: Generalized Least Squares (GLS) / Covariance-weighted Distance Network
inputs: Geometric anchors: Milky Way parallaxes, LMC/SMC DEBs, NGC4258 masers
Primary distance indicators: Cepheids, TRGB, Miras, JAGB
Secondary indicators: SNe Ia, SBF, SNe II, FP, TF

implemented_components.fitting_method: Non-linear GLS via Nelder-Mead optimization + Fisher matrix covariance

missing_from_contract.full_covariance_matrix: Simplified to diagonal errors; off-diagonal covariances not implemented
missing_from_contract.SALT2_standardization: Raw mB used instead of SALT2-fitted parameters
missing_from_contract.cosmological_DL: Simple cz/H0 used instead of full LambdaCDM luminosity distance

notable_deviations.h0_result: GLS gives H0 ≈ 109.4, not the expected 73.5 — attributed to minimal dataset limitations
notable_deviations.chi2_red: 10.67 — indicates internal tension in the simplified dataset
